replies.author: joelous
replies.body:
Hi, 
Thank you for your report, however the evidence you provided is insufficient. Those hits are very possible to make since Minecraft does not force everyone to play on the same latency - meaning, that what you see on screen is completely different on others (same goes for player positioning). This explains the "strange" hits where it looks like Destial is not looking at you. 

Have a nice day!
